components.interpretation: Host and GPU times overlap; do not add them. GPU intervals include stream idle time. Exclusive root residuals are unclassified runtime work. Capture counters describe construction only and exclude graph replay. Counter maxima are per operation, not the complete resource peak. Use unprofiled endpoints for performance claims.
